name: Real Estate Lead Pipeline → Odoo CRM

parameters.content:
## Real-Estate Lead Pipeline → Odoo CRM

Facebook Lead Ads → Normalize + Qualify + Segment (auto tag) + Auto assign → Duplicate check in Odoo → Create opportunity → Welcome automation (WhatsApp + Email + Slack to assigned desk).

**Segments:** Pool Investment, Joint Venture, Off Plan, Plot Owner, Real Estate Agent (keyword-matched in the Code node).

### Setup needed
- Connect Facebook Lead Ads, Odoo, WhatsApp, Gmail, Slack credentials
- Pick the Facebook Page + Lead Form on the trigger
- Set WhatsApp phone number ID and the Slack notifications channel
- (Optional) map each segment desk to a real Odoo user ID in the Code node to auto-assign a salesperson
